verdict.rationale: Notte is a browser-automation/agent platform (not itself an AI coding agent), and it documents an official MCP server that gives agents access to the Notte ecosystem (cloud browser sessions, page interaction, data fetching, script building), corroborated by a probe confirming the live docs page. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that the MCP server works reliably in practice beyond first-party docs.
